text.p: Carlton Myers found his shot just in time on Wednesday to lead Italian side Teamsystem Bologna to a thrilling 81-72 overtime victory in the EuroLeague over Olympiakos of Greece.
European favourites Olympiakos had outclassed Bologna 96-80 in the first leg in Athens in September but Wednesday's victory kept Bologna firmly at the top of group B.
Italian international Myers made just three of 15 shots in the first half and the Italians shot only 23 percent to trail 25-37 at the interval.

But a different Myers and Bologna showed up in the second half as American guard John Crotty came alive with 12 points and the Italians switched to a zone defence that all but shut down the Greeks, led by David Rivers with 19 points.

Myers scored 11 points in the opening minutes to cut the lead to one and when American Willy Anderson fouled out minutes later and drew a technical foul, Myers sank the two free throws to give Bologna a 44-42 lead.
The game ended at 66-66 but it was again Myers in overtime, sinking a key three-pointer after two minutes and then netting another pair of vital free throws.
Dan Gay, a U.S.-born Italian international, provided power up front for Bologna, hauling down 18 rebounds (12 offensive) and adding 12 points.
